title: Tribal Knowledge Evolution & Continuous Learning
description: Enable tribal knowledge to evolve over time through AI-driven learning. Track tip versions, merge conflicting knowledge, and surface emerging patterns for human validation.

units.title: Tip Version Control
units.description: Track evolution of tips over time with full version history, diff capability, and rollback.

units.title: Knowledge Merging Engine
units.description: Merge conflicting or overlapping tips into unified knowledge with conflict resolution.

units.title: Emerging Pattern Detection
units.description: Detect emerging patterns from LLM reasoning that should become new tribal tips.

units.title: Knowledge Lifecycle Management
units.description: Manage full lifecycle: creation, validation, promotion, deprecation, archival.

summary.ai_integration: Complete knowledge evolution system enabling version control, intelligent merging, pattern-based tip generation, and full lifecycle management for tribal knowledge
